description: Make all auth modals, character components, and document/employee drawers fully responsive for mobile devices
steps: 1. Update AuthPortal (src/components/auth/AuthPortal.tsx): ensure form container is max-w-md and p-4 on mobile, p-6 sm:p-8 on desktop. Stack demo account buttons as single column on mobile (grid-cols-1), 2 columns on sm+ (sm:grid-cols-2). Ensure all input fields and buttons have adequate touch targets (min-h-11, py-2.5 or more)

2. Update FaceRecognitionModal (src/components/auth/FaceRecognitionModal.tsx): set Modal maxWidth='lg' but add responsive padding. Video viewport should be h-[340px] on mobile, h-[380px] sm:h-[400px] on larger screens. Button row should flex-wrap on mobile. 'Upload Photo' and action buttons stack vertically on mobile

3. Update PasskeyModal (src/components/auth/PasskeyModal.tsx): already uses Modal maxWidth='md', ensure button rows flex-wrap. Text should be readable at mobile sizes. Ensure 'Register Biometric Passkey' button text is shortened on mobile: use responsive text or split into two lines

4. Update RiggedAnimeCharacter (src/components/character/RiggedAnimeCharacter.tsx): wrap canvas container with responsive width/height. Currently fixed at 558x1263 aspect ratio. Add responsive container classes: on mobile w-24 h-48 sm:w-32 sm:h-64 md:w-40 md:h-80, maintain aspect ratio with object-contain. Reduce rendering canvas size on mobile to save performance

5. Update LiveCharacter (src/components/character/LiveCharacter.tsx): speech bubble max-w-xs already present, ensure on mobile it's max-w-[200px] to avoid overflow. Character container currently w-32 h-64 sm:w-36 sm:h-72, verify these are appropriate. Minimize button and AI Assistant button should have adequate spacing and touch targets

6. Update AICompanionCharacter (src/components/character/AICompanionCharacter.tsx): floating expanded modal is w-80 sm:w-96, ensure it doesn't overflow on narrow screens. Add max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] constraint. Action cards should remain tappable with adequate padding

7. Update DocumentUploadModal (src/components/documents/DocumentUploadModal.tsx): already uses Modal maxWidth='lg'. Ensure 6-stage progress grid is grid-cols-3 on mobile, sm:grid-cols-6 on desktop (already present). Form fields should stack on mobile: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 for vault/classification/clearance row. FileDropzone touch target should be large

8. Update DocumentPreviewDrawer (src/components/documents/DocumentPreviewDrawer.tsx): drawer is max-w-3xl. On mobile (<768px) it should be full-screen width (max-w-full). Tab navigation should scroll horizontally on mobile (overflow-x-auto already present). Content area padding should reduce on mobile: p-4 on mobile, p-6 on desktop. Action buttons in header should stack or reduce size on mobile

9. Update EmployeeProfileDrawer (src/components/employees/EmployeeProfileDrawer.tsx): max-w-2xl becomes max-w-full on mobile. Tab bar and content padding adjust same as DocumentPreviewDrawer. Contact info grid should be grid-cols-1 on mobile, sm:grid-cols-2 on larger screens
acceptance_criteria: AuthPortal form fits on 375px screen without horizontal scroll, demo buttons stack vertically
FaceRecognitionModal video viewport is appropriately sized on mobile without overflow
Character components (RiggedAnimeCharacter, LiveCharacter) scale down on mobile screens and remain interactive
DocumentUploadModal form fields stack appropriately on mobile
DocumentPreviewDrawer and EmployeeProfileDrawer are full-width on mobile screens
All buttons and interactive elements in modals/drawers meet 44x44px touch target requirement
verification: Run 'npm run build' to check for TypeScript errors
Test AuthPortal at 375px: form should fit, buttons should be tappable
Test FaceRecognitionModal at 375px: video area should not overflow, buttons should wrap
Test character visibility at 375px: LiveCharacter should be smaller but visible and interactive
Test DocumentPreviewDrawer at 375px: should be full-width, tabs should scroll horizontally
Test all modals at 375px, 768px, and 1024px widths to ensure responsive behavior
